description: A discarded policy item is restored because it maps to an export-policy sentinel.

documents.title: Trade regulator opens memory-equipment rule consultation
documents.raw_text: The regulator opened a formal consultation on memory-equipment export rules.
documents.event_summary: A formal policy process could affect a dependency sentinel.

facts.statement: The regulator opened a formal memory-equipment rule consultation.

analysis.marginal_change: Initially discarded as a consultation with no final rule.

red_team.assumption_at_risk: CXMT effective capacity ramps as expected.
red_team.alternative_explanation: The consultation may end without material restrictions.
red_team.confirmation_bias: Initial triage may underweight policy lead indicators.
red_team.market_knowledge: The consultation is public but implications are unresolved.
red_team.cannot_prove: It cannot prove a restriction will be adopted.
red_team.next_validation: Review draft scope and covered equipment classifications.
red_team.worst_position_risk: A final rule materially changes effective Chinese DRAM capacity growth.
